display.name: Claude
display.description: What claude on this server cost, in tokens and dollars, by model and by day, and what it did: sessions, active time, lines of code, commits, pull requests, edit decisions, prompts, tool calls and API errors. From claude's metrics and events. Cost is claude's estimate at API prices, not what a subscription bills. Days are in UTC. Written for github.com/zadykian/ws.

display.name: Active time
display.description: The time claude was in use over the time range: the user typing, and claude running tools and waiting on the API.

display.name: Active time
display.description: Active time per day: user, the user typing, and cli, claude running tools and waiting on the API. Days are in UTC.

display.name: API errors
display.description: Requests to the API that failed after claude's retries, per day, by HTTP status. One with no status, such as a refused connection, shows without one. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Cache reads
display.description: Tokens read from the prompt cache as a share of the tokens sent, per day: cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheCreation). Days are in UTC.

display.name: Commits
display.description: Git commits claude made over the time range.

display.name: Commits and pull requests
display.description: Git commits claude made and pull requests it created, per day. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Cost
display.description: What claude's requests to the API cost over the time range: claude's estimate at API prices, in US dollars: under a subscription, it is not what was billed.

display.name: Cost by model
display.description: Cost per day, by model: claude's estimate at API prices, in US dollars: under a subscription, it is not what was billed. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Cost by source
display.description: Cost per day, by the part of claude that made the requests: main, subagent or auxiliary. claude's estimate at API prices, in US dollars: under a subscription, it is not what was billed. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Edit decisions
display.description: claude's Edit, Write and NotebookEdit calls over the time range, by decision, accept or reject, and by its source: config, a permission rule or mode; hook; user_temporary or user_permanent, the user allowing it; user_reject, the user refusing it; user_abort, the user dismissing the prompt.

display.name: Lines of code
display.description: Lines claude added and removed per day. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Lines added
display.description: Lines of code claude added over the time range.

display.name: Lines removed
display.description: Lines of code claude removed over the time range.

display.name: Prompts
display.description: Prompts per day, the user's and those claude starts a turn with itself. Their text is not sent. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Pull requests
display.description: Pull requests claude created over the time range.

display.name: Sessions
display.description: Sessions started over the time range: fresh, resumed and continued. The claude agents view is left out.

display.name: Sessions
display.description: Sessions started per day: fresh, resume or continue. The claude agents view is left out. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Tokens
display.description: Tokens of every type over the time range: input, output, and those read from and written to the prompt cache.

display.name: Tokens by model
display.description: Tokens of every type per day, by model. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Tokens by type
display.description: Tokens per day, by type: input, output, cacheRead, read from the prompt cache, and cacheCreation, written to it. input leaves out both. Days are in UTC.

display.name: Tool calls
display.description: Tool calls that ran over the time range, by tool, the 15 most frequent. Calls refused permission are left out.
